calls.title: GrowthBook Demo for Cogniteer
calls.summary: Daniel Wathne (GrowthBook sales) demonstrated the platform's focus on product and engineering teams, highlighting AI-native features like agentic experiment workflows, warehouse-native integration, and statistical rigor (Bayesian/Frequentist). Fabian Hans (Cogniteer consultant) explored GrowthBook's USP versus marketing-focused tools like VWO, seeking the best recommendation for his clients who often struggle with tracking. Next steps: a product demo scheduled for Monday, and Daniel will connect Fabian with GrowthBook's marketing leader for potential podcast or partnership discussions.

calls.title: Growthbook <> Cogniteer - Demo
calls.summary: GrowthBook’s Logan Bates and Daniel Wathne demoed their feature management, experimentation, and analytics platform to Fabian Hans of Cogniteer. Key features included SQL-free metric creation, AI-driven visual editing, MCP server integration, and support for multi-tenant customers. Next steps: Daniel will share recordings, the upcoming visual editor video, and pricing details; Fabian may introduce clients for further discussions.

calls.title: Growthbook <> Cogniteer - Demo
calls.summary: The discussion highlighted the platform's capability to integrate multi-source data, enhancing analytics and experimentation using tools like Google Analytics 4 and Segment. Automatic schema interpretation simplifies the metric creation process for non-technical users through a point-and-click interface, reducing reliance on engineers. The platform’s feature flags allow complex configurations for targeted rollouts and flexible segmentations, while its advanced analytics dashboard employs Bayesian statistics for experiment analytics. AI development is also emphasized, aiming for future tools that automate management tasks. Pricing is usage-based, favoring enterprise clients with limits on concurrent experiments for lower plans. Additionally, a hands-on support strategy for enterprise customers was discussed to ensure effective feature adoption.
calls.keywords: feature management, experimentation, AI integration, data warehouse, visual editor, pricing model
